summary.text: Josh Calloway is a Republican state representative who has represented Kentucky House of Representatives District 10 since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A pastor, he has also worked in the manufacturing and pipeline industries.

paragraphs.text: Josh Calloway's career experience includes working as a preacher, as director of Hope Through Truth Ministries and the Hope Academy, and in the manufacturing and pipeline industries.
He lost a general election for Kentucky House District 10 in 2018 and won the seat in 2020, taking office on January 1, 2021, as the successor to Dean Schamore.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Economic Development and Workforce Investment, Elections, Constitutional Amendments and Intergovernmental Affairs, and Primary and Secondary Education committees.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
